notes: Chapter title (No.035, part ① of a two-part chapter pair); 光 hikari = light, 闇 yami = darkness
text: 目覚めましたか — have you woken up?
text: 最終試験会場横の控え室です — this is the waiting room next to the final exam venue

english: heave-ho! (exclamation made when exerting effort, e.g. standing up)
notes: text: よっこいしょっと — said as Gon gets out of bed

english: in the midst of, in the middle of (doing something)
notes: text: ハンター試験の最中だったんだ — oh right, I was in the middle of the Hunter Exam

english: to stick together; (of a broken bone) to knit, to heal
notes: text: 腕はすぐくっつきますよ — your arm will heal right up soon
text: 非常にきれいに折ってくれてます — he broke it very cleanly for you
text: むしろ完治後には丈夫になるくらいのもんです — if anything, it'll be even sturdier once fully healed

english: a complete recovery, full healing (from an injury)
notes: text: 完治後には丈夫になる — once fully healed, it'll be sturdier than before

english: anyway, in any case, be that as it may
notes: text: なにはともあれ合格おめでとうございます — anyway, congratulations on passing
text: 不合格者が何を言っても合格できないのと同じく — just as a failed examinee can't pass no matter what they say
text: あとは君の気構え次第ですよ — the rest depends on your mental attitude

english: an eccentric, someone with peculiar/curious tastes
notes: text: 大金で買いたがる物好きは大勢いますからね — plenty of eccentrics would want to buy it for a lot of money

english: again, once more, a second time
notes: text: 合格した者が再び試験を受けることはできません — someone who has passed cannot take the exam again

english: to dispose of, to get rid of
notes: text: ライセンスカードを処分するのも封印するのも自由です — you're free to dispose of or seal the license card

english: to seal up, to put under seal
notes: text: 封印するのも自由です — you're also free to seal it away

english: one's predecessors, those who came before
notes: text: 先人達の偉業の甲斐もあり — thanks to the achievements of our predecessors

english: a great achievement, a great feat
notes: text: 先人達の偉業の甲斐もありプロのハンターはかなり優遇されています — thanks to predecessors' great achievements, pro hunters are treated quite favorably
text: プロのハンターはかなり優遇されています — pro hunters are given quite favorable treatment
text: 悪用のみを考えて試験を受けにくる輩も後を断ちません — there's no shortage of scoundrels who come to take the exam thinking only of abusing it

english: to never cease, to be endless (of a recurring bad phenomenon)
notes: text: 試験を受けにくる輩も後を断ちません — there's no end to the scoundrels who come to take the exam (for that reason)
text: 意味のないガラクタ同然のものでもあるのです — it's also practically worthless junk
text: ハンターになってから何を成したのかですよ — what matters is what you accomplish after becoming a Hunter

english: to devote oneself heart and soul (to something)
notes: text: 名誉を求め発掘のみに心血をそそいでいましたが — I used to pour my heart and soul solely into excavation, seeking honor
text: 発掘のみに心血をそそいでいました — I poured everything into excavation alone
text: 主に遺跡の発掘と修復・保護です — mainly excavation, restoration, and protection of ruins

english: restoration, repair (of something old or historic)
notes: text: 遺跡の発掘と修復・保護です — excavation, restoration, and protection of ruins
text: 私財を使って完璧な修繕を行い — using his personal funds, he carried out perfect repairs
text: 私財を使って完璧な修繕を行い — using his own funds, he carried out perfect repairs

english: to take into consideration, to factor in
notes: text: 将来的な遺跡の保護を考慮に入れた上で — with the future preservation of the ruins taken into consideration
text: その作業工程に打ちのめされました — I was overwhelmed by the work process itself

english: to adopt, to incorporate (a method, practice)
notes: text: 遺跡管理のマニュアルとして世界的にとりいれられているほどです — to the point that it's now adopted worldwide as the manual for ruins management

english: a model, an example to follow, a role model
notes: text: 私にとってその人が手本です — that person is a role model for me

english: to say thanks, to express one's gratitude
notes: text: 一度会って礼を言うのも私の夢の一つですね — meeting him once to thank him is also one of my dreams

english: to incur a debt, to owe someone a favor
notes: text: いろんな人に助けてもらっていっぱい借りも作ったしね — lots of people have helped me, and I've built up a lot of debts too

english: once again, afresh, formally (this time properly)
notes: Satotsu offers his hand again to shake properly after the earlier exchange

english: to end, to come to a close
notes: text: いえもう試験は終了しました — no, the exam has already ended

english: a training session, a briefing, a short course
notes: text: 他の合格者は簡単な講習を受けています — the other successful examinees are receiving a simple briefing

english: a whole day, a full 24 hours
notes: text: 君はほぼ丸一日寝てたんですよ — you slept for almost a whole day
text: 誰が…落ちたの? — who... failed?

english: to decline, to turn down (an offer or honor)
notes: text: そいつが目覚めたらきっと合格は辞退するぜ — once he wakes up, he'll surely decline passing
text: オレ達のこの後の戦いは全て無意味になるんじゃないか — won't all our subsequent fights become meaningless?
text: 本人がなんと言おうとそれは変わらんよ — no matter what he himself might say, that won't change

english: no need to worry (formal/old-fashioned set phrase)
notes: Netero's reply when Kite worries about the fairness of Gon's pass

english: I see, indeed, that makes sense
notes: text: なるほどな — I see
text: 仮にゴンがごねてワシを殺したとしても — even hypothetically, if Gon had been stubborn and killed me

english: to grumble persistently, to be stubbornly difficult, to complain to get one's way
notes: text: 仮にゴンがごねてワシを殺したとしても — even if Gon had made a fuss and killed me

english: to cancel, to revoke, to retract
notes: text: 合格した後で資格がとり消されることはない — once someone has passed, their qualification will never be revoked
text: なんでわざと負けたの? — why did you lose on purpose?

english: "I give up!", "you got me!" (set expression of surrender, from 参る)
notes: text: 殺さず「まいった」と言わせる方法くらい心得ているはずだろ — you surely know a way to make him say "I give up" without killing him

english: to know, to be versed in, to have knowledge of
notes: text: 殺さず「まいった」と言わせる方法くらい心得ているはずだろ — you surely know a way to do it without killing him
text: 誰か拷問する時は一生恨まれることを覚悟してやる — when I torture someone, I do it prepared to be resented for life

english: to be mentally prepared, to resign oneself (to something)
notes: text: 一生恨まれることを覚悟してやる — I do it prepared to be resented for the rest of their life

english: to bear a grudge against, to resent
notes: text: 誰かを拷問する時は一生恨まれることを覚悟してやる — when torturing someone, be prepared to be resented for life
text: 痛めつけられた相手を見る目には負の光が宿るもんだ — in the eyes of someone looking at an opponent they've tormented, a negative light dwells

english: to dwell in, to reside in (often figuratively)
notes: text: 負の光が宿るもんだ — a negative light dwells (in their eyes)
text: 目に映る憎しみや恨みの光ってのは訓練してもなかなか消せるもんじゃねー — the light of hatred and resentment in one's eyes isn't easily erased even through training
text: 腕を折られた直後なのによ — even though it's right after having his arm broken
text: あえて敗因をあげるならそんなとこだ — if I dare name the cause of my defeat, that's about it

english: to dare (to do something), purposely, forcibly
notes: text: あえて敗因をあげるならそんなとこだ — if I dare to name a cause of my defeat, that's about it

english: to take a liking to, to come to like
notes: text: 気に入っちまったんだあいつが — I ended up liking that guy
text: 反則による失格です — disqualification due to a foul
text: 反則による失格です — it's disqualification due to a foul

english: to cause (someone's) death, to bring about someone's death
notes: text: 相手を死にいたらしめました — he caused his opponent's death
text: 一瞬のことでした — it was a matter of an instant
text: 開始の合図と同時に — simultaneous with the starting signal
text: 開始の合図と同時に — at the same instant as the starting signal
text: 意図的に失格したものと思われます — it's believed that he intentionally got himself disqualified

english: in order, step by step, sequentially
notes: text: 順を追って話しましょう — let's go through it in order
text: ヒソカ氏が何事か囁き — Hisoka whispered something
text: ヒソカ氏が何事か囁き — Hisoka whispered something
text: その直後負けを宣言しました — immediately after, he declared his defeat
text: あっさりとポックル氏が負けを認めました — Pokkle readily admitted defeat
text: ゴン君の時と同じような体勢になりましたが — it ended up in a similar position to Gon's case
text: この一言が決め手でしたね — this one remark was the deciding factor
text: またヒソカ氏が何か耳打ちし — Hisoka again whispered something in his ear
text: 一方的な試合でしたが — it was a one-sided match, but

english: brimming with confidence, full of self-assurance
notes: text: 彼は自信たっぷりにこう言いました — he said this with plenty of confidence
text: おそらく次で勝てると判断してたんでしょう — he probably judged that he could win in the next match
text: 開始と同時にキルア氏が戦線離脱 — right at the start, Killua withdrew from the fight
text: ボドロ氏のケガを理由に延期を要求 — he requested a postponement citing Bodoro's injury

english: a miscalculation, an error in judgment
notes: text: 彼にとって最大の誤算がそこにありました — his biggest miscalculation lay there

english: it's been a while, long time no see
notes: text: 久しぶりだねキル — it's been a while, Kil[lua]
Illumi's line to Killua: 兄…貴!! — bro...ther!!
